title: Frontend Engineering Intern (Summer 2026)
location: San Francisco, CA / Hybrid / Remote Friendly
company_overview: We build fast, collaborative cloud workspace tools used by millions of developers and teams worldwide. Our engineering culture values clean code, delightful UX, rapid feedback loops, and empathetic mentorship.
responsibilities: Collaborate with product designers and backend engineers to build responsive, accessible web interfaces in React and TypeScript.
Optimize client-side performance, reduce bundle sizes, and improve Core Web Vitals across desktop and mobile browsers.
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library.
Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and bi-weekly engineering demo days.
Deliver an end-to-end user-facing feature project by the end of the 12-week program.
required_skills: Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and modern frontend web standards (HTML5/CSS3).
Hands-on experience building web apps with React (Hooks, state management, component lifecycles).
Understanding of responsive layout design (Flexbox, CSS Grid) and cross-browser quirks.
Familiarity with Git version control and collaborative pull request workflows.
preferred_skills: Experience with TypeScript in React applications.
Familiarity with Next.js, TailwindCSS, or modern UI component libraries.
Basic knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1).
Exposure to automated testing with Jest or Cypress.
cultural_competencies: Curiosity and eagerness to learn unfamiliar web technologies quickly.
Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and collaborate in cross-functional teams.
Growth mindset when receiving and incorporating constructive code review feedback.
